items.claim: Uroš Medić tends to start fights very fast and gets dropped early.
items.quote: we have seen Medic start really fast sometimes, and get dropped immediately.

items.claim: Puna Soriano was able to knock Medić down and finish him quickly.
items.quote: Puna Soriano is able to finish it, right? Medic gets dropped 30 seconds into the fight, 20 seconds into the fight and that's it.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez does not possess one-punch knockout power in the UFC.
items.quote: Dro has not knocked anybody out with one punch so far in his UFC UFC career.
